title: Car Accident in Miami, FL: Common Insurance Mistakes to Avoid
metaDescription: Miami car crash insurance pitfalls: PIP basics, recorded statements, and documentation tips. Educational guide—not legal advice.
excerpt: Florida no-fault basics and insurer tactics Miami drivers should understand after a collision.

sections.heading: Understand Florida PIP basics
paragraphs: Florida's no-fault system routes initial medical bills through Personal Injury Protection (PIP) on your policy. File required forms promptly and keep every receipt.
Serious injury thresholds may allow claims outside PIP. A licensed Florida attorney can explain whether your situation may qualify.

sections.heading: Mistakes when adjusters call
paragraphs: Recorded statements given too early can be used against you. Stick to facts, avoid speculation, and consider professional guidance before signing releases.
Quick cash offers may not cover ongoing treatment—especially with soft-tissue injuries common in low-speed Miami parking-lot crashes.
list: Do not post crash details on social media
Keep repair estimates and rental receipts
Document weather and road surface conditions

faq.question: Does Miami require a police report?
faq.answer: Reporting depends on injury and damage thresholds. Cooperate with officers when they respond; verify current Florida rules.
